document.abstract: The table herewith will augment the information detailed in Table I of the Progress Committee Report for 1970 (Journal, p. 373, May 1971). Under the heading “No. of transmitters” in Table I the figure in parentheses refers to these operating on the transmission system which is identified by the letter similarly enclosed in the preceding column. This new information lists the principal characteristics of broadcast television signals as tabulated by the C.C.I.R. (C.C.I.R. Report 308, Tenth Plenary Assembly, Geneva, 1963). The field repetition frequency is 50/s for all stations listed.
